### Discussed in https://github.com/encode/starlette/discussions/2296
Originally posted by **VietThan** October 4, 2023 ## Context I'm coming from using FastAPI but I have an endpoint where I use it in the following manner: ```py from fastapi.testclient import TestClient def test_upload(test_client: TestClient): # URL of your FastAPI endpoint url = "http://localhost:8000/upload/?param1=temp¶m2=temp" # Path to the file you want to upload file_path = "your_file.bin" # Open the file and send it as binary data in the request with open(file_path, "rb") as file: response = test_client.post(url, data=file.read()) # Print the response from the server print(response.status_code) print(response.text) ``` The endpoint itself is defined something like: ```py @app.post( '/upload/', status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, ) async def upload(request: Request) -> str: data: bytes = await request.body() s3_client = get_s3_client() key = generate_random_key() s3_client.put_object(Key=key, Body=data, Bucket=BUCKET_NAME) return key ``` ## Issue The test above works, but mypy giving me an error: ``` error: Argument "data" to "post" of "TestClient" has incompatible type "bytes"; expected "Mapping[str, str | Iterable[str]] | None" [arg-type] ``` At the moment, in `starlette/testclient.py` is the following: ```py _RequestData = typing.Mapping[str, typing.Union[str, typing.Iterable[str]]] ``` I would like to submit a PR to add `bytes` if we think how I'm using the TestClient is appropriate.
> [!IMPORTANT] > - We're using [Polar.sh](https://polar.sh/encode) so you can upvote and help fund this issue. > - We receive the funding once the issue is completed & confirmed by you. > - Thank you in advance for helping prioritize & fund our backlog.
issue.title: typing map _RequestData in testclient.py might be missing type bytes
